notes: Mathlib proof A223578_eq / A223577_eq (A223577_mathlib.lean): with f m = floor(cot(pi/(2m))), nth P78 n = 2 nth P77 n - (n+1) + 1 for all n, i.e. A223578(n) = 2*A223577(n) - n + 1; P78_infinite, P77_infinite. Key steps: f(-j) = -ceil(cot(pi/(2j))), 3/5 <= cot(pi/(2(j+1))) - cot(pi/(2j)) <= 1 (incr, via sin(b-a)/(sin a sin b) and x - x^3/6 < sin x < x), counting invariants inv1, inv2. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Side finding: the A223577 FORMULA a(n) = floor(cot(Pi/(2*A223578(n)))) fails for all n >= 2 (needs ceiling). Outside Lean: that P77, P78 transcribe the OEIS definitions (certificate/check.py matches both b-files, n <= 10000).
